barcode.title: Barcode generator
barcode.description: Create Code 128, EAN-13 and more as PNG.
barcode.options: Enter the value to encode in the box, then run the tool to generate a downloadable PNG.

ocr.title: OCR - image & PDF
ocr.description: Extract selectable text from an image or PDF.
ocr.hint: Choose one image or PDF file.
ocr.options: Resolution applies to PDF pages only; higher DPI can improve small-text recognition but takes longer and uses more memory. The OCR engine and language data download on first use and are cached by your browser. Files are processed locally and never uploaded.

pdf-flatten.title: Flatten PDF
pdf-flatten.description: Render each page to an image so the text layer is removed.
pdf-flatten.options: Flattening removes the selectable text layer, but it can increase the file size, break text search and copy/paste, and reduce accessibility. It does not make a document confidential - OCR can still read the page images.

pdf-ocr.title: Make PDF searchable
pdf-ocr.description: Add an invisible, selectable text layer to a scanned PDF with OCR.
pdf-ocr.hint: Choose one scanned or image-only PDF.
pdf-ocr.options: OCR runs locally with Tesseract.js. The engine and language data (a few MB) download from a CDN on first use and are then cached. Pages are rasterised, so the original look is kept but any existing selectable text is replaced by the new text layer.

pdf-unlock.title: Unlock PDF
pdf-unlock.description: Remove password protection from a PDF you own.
pdf-unlock.hint: Choose the protected PDF. Enter its password if the document asks for one.
pdf-unlock.options: Only unlock documents you are allowed to open. Decryption happens in your browser - the file is never uploaded.

pdf-protect.title: Protect PDF
pdf-protect.description: Add AES-256 password protection and set document permissions.
pdf-protect.options: The file is encrypted locally with AES-256. There is no recovery option - keep the password safe. Open the result in a PDF reader to confirm the protection before sharing it.

pdf-sign.title: Sign PDF
pdf-sign.description: Add a typed signature and date to a PDF.
pdf-sign.options: This adds a visible typed signature. It is not a cryptographic certificate signature and does not prove who signed the document.

pdf-redact.title: Redact PDF
pdf-redact.description: Permanently cover matching text and remove it from the page.
pdf-redact.hint: Choose one PDF containing selectable text.
pdf-redact.options: Matching uses the PDF's selectable text layer. Any page containing a match is flattened, so all text on that page stops being selectable or searchable. Use OCR first for scanned pages. Separate search phrases with new lines or commas.

pdf-compare.title: Compare PDFs
pdf-compare.description: See which lines of text changed between two PDFs.
pdf-compare.hint: Choose exactly two PDFs. The newest two files are kept.
pdf-compare.options: The report always lists every page, matching-line counts, and added or removed lines. Turn on the option to include all matching text for unchanged pages. Scanned pages need OCR first; line wrapping and layout-only edits may appear as differences.

jpg-to-pdf.title: JPG to PDF
jpg-to-pdf.description: Combine JPG photos into one PDF document.
jpg-to-pdf.hint: Choose one or more JPG or JPEG images.
jpg-to-pdf.options:
Marginpt

Each image gets its own page in the order shown. Drag files in the list to reorder them before converting.

word-to-pdf.title: Word to PDF
word-to-pdf.options: Headings, paragraphs, lists, tables and embedded images are converted locally to PDF. Legacy .doc files must first be saved as .docx. Complex layouts and some fonts may shift. Your document is never uploaded.

powerpoint-to-pdf.title: PowerPoint to PDF
powerpoint-to-pdf.options: Slides, text, images and notes layout are converted locally to PDF. Legacy .ppt files must first be saved as .pptx. Some animations, transitions and theme fonts may not carry over.

excel-to-pdf.title: Excel to PDF
excel-to-pdf.options: Worksheets, cell values and tables are converted locally to PDF. Legacy .xls files must first be saved as .xlsx. Very wide sheets and charts may be simplified.

html-to-pdf.title: HTML to PDF
html-to-pdf.description: Convert a saved HTML file into a PDF.
html-to-pdf.options: The HTML file is rendered locally into PDF pages. Styles inside the file are applied; external images, fonts and scripts may not load. Very long pages are split automatically.

pdf-to-jpg.title: PDF to JPG
pdf-to-jpg.description: Render each PDF page as a JPG image.
pdf-to-jpg.options: Each page becomes a separate JPG. Leave the pages box empty for every page, or enter ranges such as 1-3, 5. Download individual images or all of them as a ZIP.

pdf-to-word.title: PDF to Word
pdf-to-word.description: Convert selectable PDF text into a DOCX document.
pdf-to-word.hint: Choose one PDF containing selectable text.
pdf-to-word.options: Extracts the selectable text layer into paragraphs in a Word document. Scanned PDFs need OCR first. Images, columns and complex layouts are simplified, so this is best for text-heavy documents.

pdf-to-powerpoint.title: PDF to PowerPoint
pdf-to-powerpoint.description: Turn each PDF page into a slide image.
pdf-to-powerpoint.options: Each PDF page becomes a picture on its own slide. Text is not editable in PowerPoint, but the slide layout matches each page's shape.

pdf-to-excel.title: PDF to Excel
pdf-to-excel.description: Place PDF text into rows and columns in an XLSX workbook.
pdf-to-excel.hint: Choose one PDF containing selectable text.
pdf-to-excel.options: Each page becomes a worksheet. Text is grouped into rows and columns using its position, so tabular PDFs work best. Scanned PDFs need OCR first; complex layouts may need manual clean-up in Excel.

pdf-to-pdfa.title: PDF to PDF/A
pdf-to-pdfa.description: Create an archival PDF/A copy with XMP metadata.
pdf-to-pdfa.options: Adds the PDF/A identifier, XMP metadata and an embedded sRGB output intent. Rasterising pages improves compatibility but removes selectable text. This is a best-effort conversion - validate strict conformance with veraPDF.

url-codec.options: Encodes and decodes URL components (not entire URLs with reserved delimiters). UTF-8 text is supported.
